chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn al-Qaddah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Tawaf before the Hajj is superior to seventy Tawafs after the Hajj.

key_terms.طَوَاف: Tawaf, the ritual circumambulation of the Kaaba

ai.seo_question: What is the superior time for performing Tawaf in relation to Hajj according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Al-Kafi*, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to emphasize the spiritual precedence of the initial circumambulation, often identified with *Tawaf al-Qada* or the preparatory *Tawaf*, over the concluding *Tawaf al-Ifadah*. This comparative merit underscores the Shia scholarly view that the intention and timing of worship significantly influence its reward, positioning the pre-Hajj Tawaf as a superior act of devotion than seventy repetitions performed post-rites. The hadith serves as a key text in discussions regarding the hierarchy of Hajj rituals within Shia fiqh.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Al Qaddah, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Tawaaf before the Hajj is superior than seventy Tawaafs after the Hajj’.
en.sarwar: 3. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from ibn Faddal from ibn al-Qaddah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
performing Tawaf before al-Hajj is more excellent than seventy Tawaf after al-Hajj.”
